Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide workflow scene for a project of the Olympuz family
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column; Image 3 is the project character sheet and Image 4 the project prop sheet - the figure, the herald staff, the marble tablet and the gold ribbon must match those sheets exactly.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape. The subject reads clearly at the centre, the figure never overlaps it. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right as the family signature. Generous empty ivory space, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble sculpture render, monumental carving with deep drapery, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and unhurried. Gold glows softly from within, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for the ribbon and the staff only, sky blue #B8D6EA for the ground paths only, charcoal #3E3A36
Primary request: the fourth and last step - the text arrives exactly where it was needed. The scene must read as a delivery completed.
Subject: the marble writing tablet lies flat on a low marble table at the centre, its single carved groove facing the viewer and now completely filled with muted gold along its whole length. Iris stands to the right of the table, already stepping away, her body turned toward the far edge of the frame, her head still turned back to the tablet, the herald staff in her lowered right hand. The gold ribbon ends inside the groove and nowhere else.
Constraints:
- The groove is filled edge to edge. No ribbon remains in the air.
- Everything rests on the ground and casts a shadow. Nothing hovers.
- Her head is uncovered, eyes open, hair parted in the centre and gathered low at the nape, wings folded, exactly as on the character sheet.
- Anatomically correct hands with exactly five fingers and one readable thumb, fingers not fused.
- Preserve the reference style; highest final quality; maximum resolution.
Avoid: rainbow of many colors, prismatic colors, veil, helmet, crown, blindfold, closed eyes, floating objects, screens, keyboards, microphones, cables, brand marks, dark background, black background, neon, purple gradient, smoky cinema lighting, heavy bronze, metallic or plastic marble, watermark, extra or missing fingers, fused fingers, callout labels
Text (verbatim): No readable text, no letters, no digits anywhere in the image.
